core_categories: Medical Supplies; Mobility Aids; Daily Living Aids; Bathroom Safety; Home Medical Equipment; Patient Care Supplies
specialty_focus: Health Products For You is an online retailer of medical supplies and health products, specializing in home care products for seniors, caregivers, and individuals with disabilities or chronic conditions. It offers a wide range of categories including mobility aids, daily living aids, bathroom safety, and home medical equipment. The company does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
